rca.categoryTitle: Element Locator Timeout / DOM Element Not Found
rca.summary: Playwright timed out while waiting for locator locator('header, nav, [role="navigation"], .main-nav, .MuiAppBar-root, .navbar, table, #root, #app') to become actionable on AT&T Dev2 (ACM).
rca.rootCause: The UI element either did not render within the configured 15,000ms action timeout, was occluded by a loading spinner (e.g. '.lds-pacman'), or the DOM hierarchy changed in the target portal release.
suggestedRemediation: Ensure explicit spinner dismissal before locating: await page.locator('.lds-pacman').waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 30000 });
Verify if the element is inside an iframe or nested Material-UI portal modal dialog.
Increase locator action timeout if testing across high-latency staging environments (AT&T Dev2 (ACM)).

rca.categoryTitle: Element Locator Timeout / DOM Element Not Found
rca.summary: Playwright timed out while waiting for locator locator('header, nav, [role="navigation"], .main-nav, .MuiAppBar-root, .navbar, table, #root, #app') to become actionable on AT&T Dev2 (ACM).
rca.rootCause: The UI element either did not render within the configured 15,000ms action timeout, was occluded by a loading spinner (e.g. '.lds-pacman'), or the DOM hierarchy changed in the target portal release.
suggestedRemediation: Ensure explicit spinner dismissal before locating: await page.locator('.lds-pacman').waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 30000 });
Verify if the element is inside an iframe or nested Material-UI portal modal dialog.
Increase locator action timeout if testing across high-latency staging environments (AT&T Dev2 (ACM)).

rca.categoryTitle: Element Locator Timeout / DOM Element Not Found
rca.summary: Playwright timed out while waiting for locator locator('header, nav, [role="navigation"], .main-nav, .MuiAppBar-root, .navbar, table, #root, #app') to become actionable on AT&T Dev2 (ACM).
rca.rootCause: The UI element either did not render within the configured 15,000ms action timeout, was occluded by a loading spinner (e.g. '.lds-pacman'), or the DOM hierarchy changed in the target portal release.
suggestedRemediation: Ensure explicit spinner dismissal before locating: await page.locator('.lds-pacman').waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 30000 });
Verify if the element is inside an iframe or nested Material-UI portal modal dialog.
Increase locator action timeout if testing across high-latency staging environments (AT&T Dev2 (ACM)).
